items.title: The inverse image of the universal module of differentials is the universal module of differentials of the inverse images
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the inverse image of the universal module of differentials of a homomorphism of sheaves of rings with the universal module of differentials of the inverse images, compatibly with the universal derivations (author lemma at source lines 5095-5104, label lemma-pullback-differentials). The proof (source lines 5106-5118) uses that both modules are cokernels of the same kind of displayed map, that the inverse image functor is exact, and that it commutes with forming the free module on the sets of local sections, checking the three free modules appearing in the defining map (proof lines 5107-5117). The bookkeeping of the exactness and of the three free modules is the content; the defining map is reproduced as a context span. H2.
